g.text: MA01 · MAJOR DIRECTION OR BREAKING CHANGE
g.title: Define business/technical objective
Affected APIs, dependencies, users and upgrade paths
Resolve significant design choices before coding
Represent phases, sequencing and dependencies
Jules for bounded slice, Codex/Agy for broad changes
Small incremental PR; management tracks related stacks
Alternative path or authorised handoff

g.text: MA08 · PR, CI AND COMPATIBILITY EVIDENCE
g.title: Check real tests, migrations and stack relationships
Continue same roadmap or request redesign
Human decides merge and later publication
